variants.name: 1 – Geteilte Eckleisten
variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup, precise-object-edit. Create ONE polished wide 16:9 full gameplay screenshot showing a redesigned HUD for Tiefenhall. Input image 1 is EDIT TARGET: preserve its mountain landscape, sky, buildings, crystal, player, grass, underground, composition and proportions. Remove editor chrome and all old HUD, replace only HUD overlay. Input image 2 is the MANDATORY ART STYLE REFERENCE for all new UI: rich dark stained horizontal wood grain, hand-painted fantasy game art, beautifully shaded beveled warm golden brass edges, angular sculpted riveted corner caps, bright thin gold inner rails, cream classic serif lettering, realistic illustrated mining item icons, selected state orange-gold illuminated wood as in the Täglich tab and Zurück button. EXACTLY follow this style, not futuristic, no glass, no minimalist flat graphics, no steampunk gauges. Do not copy the challenges content or large modal into gameplay. HUD must show ONLY health red, energy amber, coin 100, Punkte 0, Tiefe 0 m, equipped pickaxe, eight quick slots numbered 1–8 with torch quantity 5 in slot 1 and ladder quantity 10 in slot 3. Other slots empty wood. No extra metrics. Large crisp item art and readable text, compact screen-edge scale, keep playfield clear. No design title, explanations, tips, watermark or developer text. LAYOUT A — SPLIT CORNER RAILS: top left a wide low walnut board, two thin horizontal rows of faceted red ruby health segments and golden energy segments with heart / lightning icons on left. Top right one horizontal walnut board with three adjacent compartments for coin, Punkte and Tiefe. Center of sky left completely clear. Bottom center one cohesive straight long wooden hotbar tray with shared gold dividers, attached slightly larger pickaxe socket on left; eight square recesses, angular riveted brass end caps. Frame design closely matches the reference challenge cards, but compact. Selected pickaxe socket orange golden wood. Balanced understated premium craftsmanship.
